kind: controlled exact substitution replay; not end-to-end timing

prototype.note: Local Integral, Reduction, error and noncancelling context types avoid library rebuild races; coefficient arithmetic uses the same Symbolica dependency.

fixture.note: Frozen intermediate native checkpoint; neither an upstream timing reference nor a completed reduction.

method.selection: Withhold twelve reachable same-sector rules with a direct unresolved same-sector child, ordered by descending shortest graph depth and integral index; reintroduce four per round.
method.timed_work: Construct an Expander and perform exact filtered substitution. Fresh runs start from the original target; incremental runs start from the preceding weighted frontier.
method.initial_expansion: Required by both approaches; not included in update speedup ratios.
method.repetitions: One controlled three-round sequence per sector, not three repeats of identical work; fresh then incremental in each round.
method.precision: Exact integer/rational polynomial arithmetic; no numerical tolerance.
method.validation: Every target/leaf coefficient difference is exactly zero after Symbolica rational arithmetic, including missing-zero cases.
method.concurrency: Each process pinned to one logical CPU; both sector cases and other development work ran concurrently.
method.limitations: These artificial append-only rounds use actual checkpoint rules but do not reproduce chronological native search batches. Results are prototype substitution measurements, not production or AMFlow end-to-end speedups. Reproduction requires the local checkpoint and prototype, which are not included in this report.
